meta.name: Beichte Einer Liebestollen, Sabena, Hay Country Swingers )
meta.description:
Sabine (Karin Gotz) heads to the city looking for love. She finds something like love in the arms of the people she meets there. 
I could not find subtiles for this, so it is German. This one is longer than the dubbed English version, but not as long as the 88 minutes listed at IMDb
